name: Greenpill
summary:
Greenpill transforms how professionals prepare for the moments that matter most. Whether you're training for a presentation, a difficult customer conversation, a courtroom hearing or a multi-agency crisis meeting, Greenpill puts you inside the experience.

Join a live session from your Meta Quest headset by scanning a QR code, no complex setup required. Your facilitator manages the session from a web dashboard, guiding you through immersive environments and real-time scenarios designed to build confidence
